package notes
import("testing";"os";"encoding/json";"path/filepath")
func TestHistoricalFixture(t *testing.T){
 m:=New();id,e:=m.Add();if e!=nil{t.Fatal(e)}
 if e=m.Update(id,"Résumé 😀","Historical fixture\r\ne\u0301 אבג\nLast line\n");e!=nil{t.Fatal(e)}
 if e=m.SetPinned(id,true);e!=nil{t.Fatal(e)}
 b,e:=m.CaptureNotebook();if e!=nil{t.Fatal(e)}
 data,e:=EncodeNotebook(b);if e!=nil{t.Fatal(e)}
 dir:=os.Getenv("VELLUM_COMPAT_OUTPUT");if dir==""{t.Fatal("fixture output required")}
 if e=os.WriteFile(filepath.Join(dir,"notes-build13.vellumnotes"),data,0600);e!=nil{t.Fatal(e)}
 r,e:=encodeRecovery(Recovery{Version:1,Notebook:&b});if e!=nil{t.Fatal(e)}
 if e=os.WriteFile(filepath.Join(dir,"recovery-build13.vellumnotes"),r,0600);e!=nil{t.Fatal(e)}
 if input:=os.Getenv("VELLUM_COMPAT_READ");input!=""{data,e=os.ReadFile(input);if e!=nil{t.Fatal(e)};if _,e=DecodeNotebook(data);e!=nil{t.Fatal(e)};var v any;if e=json.Unmarshal(data,&v);e!=nil{t.Fatal(e)}}
}
